title: lathyrus subalpinus
intro: Lathyrus subalpinus, commonly known as the Alpine Pea or Alpine Peavy, is a perennial flowering plant that belongs to the legume family, Fabaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus subalpinus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic applications of this plant.
